components.title: Filter and deduplicate
components.what: Keep only orders with status shipped or pending. Deduplicate exact duplicate rows: O2848 (C105, Bolt, 5, 134.73, 2026-04-26, pending) appears twice and O2746 (C104, Flange, 17, 80.70, 2026-05-21, pending) appears twice; count each once.

components.title: Compute revenue per customer
components.what: For each deduplicated eligible order, compute revenue = units * unit_price, then sum by customer. The highest total is Parker (C100) with 10105.99, not Blake.

components.title: Identify highest-revenue customer
components.what: Compare customer totals and report the name of the customer with the maximum total revenue.

asked: List every eligible (shipped or pending, post-deduplication) order ID for C107 with its units x unit_price, and reconcile the per-order figures to the stated total of 13741.09, so the gap to C103 can be audited.

State exactly which rows in the Orders CSV are exact duplicates (order_id and all fields identical), which customers they belong to, and confirm that no duplicate row affects C103's or C107's totals; also state whether counting the duplicates twice would change the ranking for any customer.
Give the per-order breakdown for C100 supporting the stated 12627.96, including which C100 rows were excluded and why.
replies:
Eligible orders for C107 (Emery) with status 'shipped' or 'pending':
- O2658 (pending): 28 × 30.16 = 844.48
- O2431 (pending): 35 × 126.49 = 4,427.15
- O2074 (pending): 42 × 53.67 = 2,254.14
- O2505 (shipped): 32 × 136.19 = 4,358.08
- O2531 (shipped): 22 × 84.42 = 1,857.24
Excluded orders for C107: O2575 (cancelled: 9 × 92.89) and O2648 (cancelled: 18 × 85.73).
Summing eligible orders: 844.48 + 4,427.15 + 2,254.14 + 4,358.08 + 1,857.24 = 13,741.09.
The gap between C103 (15,264.01) and C107 (13,741.09) is exactly 1,522.92 in favor of C103.

There are exactly three duplicate rows appearing in the CSV:
1. O2848 (C105, Bolt, 5, 134.73, 2026-04-26, pending) appears twice (revenue = 673.65).
2. O2746 (C104, Flange, 17, 80.70, 2026-05-21, pending) appears twice (revenue = 1,371.90).
3. O2863 (C105, Flange, 45, 50.84, 2026-06-27, shipped) appears twice (revenue = 2,287.80).
These duplicates belong exclusively to C104 and C105; neither C103 nor C107 has duplicate rows.
If counted twice, C104 increases by 1,371.90 to 7,327.69 (still 8th place, below Finley C106 at 8,532.98), and C105 increases by 2,961.45 (673.65 + 2,287.80) to 7,006.79 (moving C105 from 9th to 9th, or 8th if C104 was not duplicated, but still well below C106 at 8,532.98). Counting duplicates twice would not change the top 7 rankings at all, and Blake (C103) remains #1.
